MADO.description: Mesh Analysis Domain (MADO). Defines a named analysis domain characterized by its element type, material, property, and sub type; all keys are required and describe the domain assigned to the given key id.

NAME.description: Domain name (free-text label for this analysis domain).

TYPE.description: Element type code for the domain (integer element-type identifier).

MATL.description: Material id referenced by the domain.

PROP.description: Element property id referenced by the domain.

SUB_TYPE.description: Sub type code refining the element type of the domain.
